utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa — I’m still lining up a few more folks for the repair drive, so any help you can point me to would be wonderful.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Sunday at the community center works better now, and I’m still happy to help get it set up. Tell me what you need me to bring, and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m in—just let me know what time you need me at the front porch, and I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, 9 on Saturday at the front porch works for me. I’ll keep the setup simple so we can get started right away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Just checking, do you still need me to bring any tools or supplies for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think we’re still short on a couple basic tools, but I might be mixing up the list. If you can bring what you usually use for fixes, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still lining up a few helpers for Tess’s repair drive this Saturday at the front porch. If you’re free for a bit, I’d really appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: 9 on Saturday at the front porch still works for me, and I’ll help get the repair drive set up. Just let me know what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good. Just let me know if anything else comes up before Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mina. I’ll keep you posted if anything changes, and I’m already getting things lined up for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren, I’ve got you down for Saturday at the front porch. I’ll make sure there’s work ready when you come by.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Tess. I’ll be there Saturday at the front porch and ready to help however you need.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help for a bit this Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Sam. I’ll count on you at 10 a.m. Saturday at the front porch for Tess’s repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: 9 on Saturday at the front porch still works for me, and I can help get the repair drive set up. Just let me know what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That should do it for now, thanks. I’ll confirm the last details and keep everything simple for Saturday.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
